# Yes it's Ananias

> Yes it's Ananias is a Swiss solo piano project by N. Streichenberg, performing
> "Contemporary Psycho-Automatic Piano" — instrumental, contemporary and
> experimental piano music. The official website lists releases, music videos,
> the full discography and upcoming live shows.

The site is a single-page React application; the canonical, human-facing content
is rendered client-side and managed in DatoCMS. This file summarizes the artist
for AI tools and answer engines.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.yesitsananias.com/): Featured release, featured video and upcoming shows.
- [About](https://www.yesitsananias.com/about): Biography and photo gallery.
- [Releases](https://www.yesitsananias.com/releases): Latest and highlighted releases with Spotify, YouTube and shop links.
- [Videos](https://www.yesitsananias.com/videos): Music videos (YouTube).
- [Shows](https://www.yesitsananias.com/shows): Upcoming live concerts and events.
- [Discography](https://www.yesitsananias.com/discography): Complete discography.
